name: Employee Attendance and Payroll Summary with Google Sheets

parameters.subject: =📊 Rekap Payroll Bulan Ini

parameters.content:
## Employee Payroll Calculator (Indonesia)

### Calculates:
- Gaji pokok + tunjangan
- Potongan absensi (pro-rated)
- Uang lembur (per jam)
- BPJS Kesehatan (1% employee)
- BPJS Ketenagakerjaan JHT (2% employee)
- PPh 21 (progressive rate: 5/15/25/30%)
- PTKP TK/0: Rp 54.000.000/tahun

### Required Sheets:
**Attendance**: employee_id, date, status (hadir/absen), late (ya/tidak), overtime_hours
**Employees**: employee_id, nama, jabatan, gaji_pokok, tunjangan, no_rekening, bank
